issue: No placeholder/field consistency validation; previews render unresolved placeholders
actual: Submitted a template whose content used {{sprintName}}, {{owner}}, {{highlights}} while the only declared field was "Sprint Name" (key {{sprint_name}}). Submission succeeded ("Template submitted!"), despite the declared field having no matching placeholder and three placeholders having no declared field. Opening the template shows only one input, and the generated preview renders literally: "Retro for {{sprintName}} / Owner: {{owner}} / Highlights / {{highlights}}" — 3 unresolved placeholders.

evidence: On successful submit the dialog closed, a "Template submitted!" toast appeared, and the count changed from "Showing 6 of 6" to "Showing 7 of 7" with the new card rendered — no page reload (URL unchanged).

Dialog stayed open and library count unchanged in every case.
